name: Bun Xiem Lo
summary: A Khmer border bowl of thin rice noodles in a snakehead broth with fresh turmeric and lemongrass, the fish served as cake or in pieces. The broth is naturally sweet from the fish, with the salty heat of muối ớt.
origin: Khmer cooking along the southwestern border, including the Khmer communities of Tây Ninh.
culture: It is on a 2021–2022 list of 100 Vietnamese specialties from Tổ chức Kỷ lục Việt Nam.
taste: Naturally sweet from the fish, fragrant with turmeric and lemongrass, and salty-hot from muối ớt.
howToEat: It is a breakfast or lunch bowl. Add rau kèo nèo, chopped rau tai tượng, and bean sprouts.
where: Khmer communities along the border, not Tân Ninh or Trảng Bàng.
seoTitle: Bun Xiem Lo — snakehead noodles on the border
seoDescription: Bún Xiêm Lo, a Khmer snakehead noodle bowl with turmeric, lemongrass, and salt-chili.
